articles.title: Critical 9.9 Dell Enterprise SONiC Flaw Could Let Hackers Execute Malicious Commands on Network Switches
articles.summary:
Dell Technologies has patched a critical flaw in Dell Enterprise SONiC Distribution that could let a remote attacker with limited privileges run commands of their choice on an affected network switch. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-103782, could also expose files and directories the attacker is not authorized to access. It affects software versions before 4.6.1. […]
